content: Jerusalem Dae Sakai Sari Da Yaruri.

content.text: Nandae eminge sisera aindae, ivuga useni,
“Javi e namonde Bajari da tafaroro kamboda yaore!”
Arie Jerusalem ko, namane refara buveri,
ninda furu jokada fetirera!
Jerusalem sekago bogu begaya beká dighi anumbuseri,
garigo beká takegha takegha itutuseri.
Bajari Israel da oro oro aikena rea sisira, ava use,
Bajari da natofo isasambu nundae sakai saridae,
vasa eminda viti foa gheraera.
David da imemisiri kini (king) edo ghusera,
vasa eminda anumbedo, nenda natofo Israel embo da mema bouvu ijujeoro
dambu edo ghusira.
Jerusalem aminda dubo jama sirorare dae banungaore!
“Evetu genembo nindae ghamo buraera aikena, fakina sirorare!”
Ninda furu jokáda natofo nange dubo jamaghae iroro,
kotugo ainghae dabade kokotofu da kambo babai iritirera aminda,
dara a mema bouvu eni erá tereure dae benunu resena.
Nanda nano namendi a kokomana Jerusalem irera kotise,
Jerusalem dae resena, “Dubo jama nimokena irare!”
Namondeda Bajari God da tafaroro kambo eminda irira
aindae kotise, reighi einda jokáda irari eveva sirorare dae banungerena.
